programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Lashkar

programme.title: 6 Candles

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha

programme.desc: Mae'n amser i ni gael stori fach cyn cysgu. Heddiw cawn stori am fwnci sydd ar goll. Let's get ready for a bedtime story. Today's story is about a missing monkey.

programme.title: New: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae Ger a Gu yn dechrau chwerthin wrth wylio byd natur ger y llyn - ond mae'r llyn yn chwerthin nôl! Ger and Gu get the giggles while spotting nature by a lake - but the lake giggles back!

programme.title: Amser Maith Maith Yn Ol

programme.title: Cymylaubychain

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindau

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu

programme.title: Octonots

programme.title: Annibendod

programme.title: Y Tralalas
